text: Given the Monthly Technology Report agent for American Ambulance of Visalia, When a new thread asks it to generate and email the September 2026 report to mspbots_reports@emdnet.com, Then the received email's attachment is byte-identical to monthly-technology-report_american-ambulance-of-visalia_2026-09.html (~57 KB), not a placeholder
steps: Open the Monthly Technology Report agent (sopId=41) and start a new thread in chat
Send: "Generate the September 2026 monthly technology report for American Ambulance and email it to mspbots_reports@emdnet.com."
Let the run complete (all three page agents, Executive Brief, Action Register, bind, send)
Check the email received at mspbots_reports@emdnet.com
Compare the attachment's bytes/sha256 against the report artifact the run itself produced
expect: The email's attachment is byte-identical to the generated monthly-technology-report_american-ambulance-of-visalia_2026-09.html (~57 KB); it is not a placeholder HTML file
notes: This is the actual bug repro from PRD-20703/PRD-20707. Not executed by the design leg -- no live agent/mailbox session available in this sandbox (see doc Open Questions). This is the only case that confirms whether the SOP agent has switched to the content_url path after the PRD-20707 fix; TC2-TC8 only confirm the ms-graph-mcp mechanism in isolation.

text: Given graph_send_mail is called with attachments=[{content_url: <https link>}], When the host is allow-listed and the fetch succeeds, Then the attachment delivered matches the fetched bytes exactly (same sha256)
Given a content_url fetch fails (non-200 response or network error), When graph_send_mail is called, Then no email is sent at all
Given a content_url file exceeds the 2.5 MB per-file cap, When graph_send_mail is called, Then the attachment is rejected and nothing is sent (not truncated into a smaller wrong file)
Given a content_url host that is not on the configured allow-list, When graph_send_mail is called, Then the host is rejected before any network request is made
Given the allow-list is configured empty, When a content_url attachment is supplied, Then content_url is disabled entirely (not "allow all")

Given an inline attachment (content_text/content_base64) over the pre-existing 500 KB per-file or 700 KB combined caps, When graph_send_mail is called, Then it is rejected exactly as before this fix -- the new content_url path does not change inline behavior
Given two sequential graph_send_mail calls with different inline attachments, When the second call is made, Then no state from the first call's attachments leaks into it
